text: Drained quark is mixed with Natron, which takes up acid, and left to turn glassy. It is then warmed while stirring until it runs, enriched with butter and seasoned with salt and caraway.

sources.text: The table, the facts and the words on how it is made, from these.

steps.note: The acid in the quark is taken up by it.

steps.name: rest
steps.note: The quark is left, up to several days, until it turns glassy and yellowish.
The quark is stirred as it warms, until it runs.

steps.name: season
steps.note: Butter, salt and caraway are added to it.
